DESCRIPTION

David Ross Estate Agents, your local property experts, are delighted to present new to the market for sale No.161 Cherryfield Road. This marvellous 5 bedroom end terrace property comes to the market in excellent condition throughout, eagerly awaiting its lucky new owners to turn the key.

Number 161 is situated in this highly sought after area of Walkinstown and benefits from a host of local amenities. To include many shops, parks, sports facilities and the Ashleaf Shopping Centre right on your doorstep. 

Starting off with the walk up to the property you have a large front garden with ample off street parking space. Entering the property you have a bright entrance hallway which sets the tone for what the rest of the property has to offer. Downstairs briefly comprises a small but cosy front reception room. A larger, more open living room which includes a classic feature fireplace. Towards the rear is a beautiful extended kitchen/dining area which is fully fitted. A third reception like room which could be utilised as a home office, and finishing off downstairs there is a convenient family bathroom.

To the rear you have a vast back garden which is South East facing making it an ideal sunny, relaxing space. To the very rear of the garden is a large built shed which leads to lane access.

Upstairs you have an extended double bedroom, a large double bedroom alongside two small bathrooms. To the front you have two double bedrooms and a single bedroom. Upstairs also comprises a convenient storage closet.


Cherryfield has great public transport links with bus routes such as the F3 and S4 only a short stroll away. The M50 motorway is only a five minute drive away which opens up access to the Greater Dublin Area and surrounding counties.

This magnificent property is a fantastic opportunity and not one that should be missed.
Viewing by appointment only.

Features:
- Off street parking
- Extended
- Large shed/lane access
- Prime location
